name: Yume Kitamura
source:
Star Sign: Cancer
Elemental Attribute: Unknown
Special Attribute: Luck 5
Starting Spell: Healing 3
Symbol: A wand with a small star on it (Level 2)

A bright and optimistic girl.
She was abandoned in front of Akito's house when she was a baby and they were raised together like true siblings.
In order to meet the Golden Dragon that can grant any wish she enrolls into Silver Star Academy along with Akito.
